stories.title: Driver caught on phone in Flintshire had no licence, insurance or MOT
stories.summary: A van has been seized in Flintshire after its driver was spotted using a mobile phone at the wheel, with checks then finding he had no valid licence, insurance or MOT. stories.title: Drought status declared for North Wales after wildfires and record-low river flows
stories.summary: Drought has been declared across North Wales, including the river catchments covering Flintshire, after widespread wildfires, record-low river flows and weeks of hot, dry weather. stories.title: North Wales Police renew summer road safety appeal following fatal motorcycle collision
stories.summary: North Wales Police have renewed their summer road safety appeal after 13 fatal collisions on the region’s roads so far this year, seven of them involving motorcycles. stories.title: Boccard UK’s Deeside site to build tanks for £5bn Sizewell C project
stories.summary: Sizewell C has awarded a contract to Boccard UK to manufacture stainless steel tanks at its Deeside facility. The company said the contract covers the fabrication and pre-assembly of high-integrity tanks, which will be built into reinforced concrete structures across Sizewell C’s Nuclear Island.
